title: dodag.py: code duplication between _would_accept_dio_with_snapshot and _would_accept_dio_unlocked
description:
**File:** python/src/lichen/rpl/dodag.py

**Severity:** P2 (maintenance risk)

**Summary:** Lines 196-264 (_would_accept_dio_with_snapshot) and lines 464-524 (_would_accept_dio_unlocked) contain nearly identical logic (~70 lines). They evaluate the same acceptance criteria but one uses a snapshot object and one uses self.*.

**Failure scenario:** If one function is updated (e.g., to fix a bug or add a new check) without updating the other, the authenticated DIO path and unauthenticated DIO path will have divergent acceptance criteria.

**Recommendation:** Extract the shared logic into a single function that takes the relevant values as parameters, eliminating duplication.
